golden.answer:
A grounded answer consults the current official Stellar documentation, directly answers the question with source-supported content, and dates any version-, provider-, or availability-sensitive claim. As of 2026-11-02, the verified sources supported this observed answer:

- **SEP-43 — "Standard Web Wallet API Interface"** (Status: **Draft**, v1.2.1, created 2024-04-11) defines a common JavaScript API that web wallets expose to dapps so developers integrate once instead of writing per-wallet abstractions [1].
- The interface methods are **`getAddress`, `signTransaction`, `signAuthEntry`, `signMessage`, and `getNetwork`**, plus standardized error shapes (`message`/`code`/`ext`, with codes -1 internal, -2 external service, -3 invalid request, -4 user rejected) [1].
- It exists as `ecosystem/sep-0043.md` in stellar/stellar-protocol — it is **not** an unassigned gap [1].

The dated example is illustrative: a later grounded answer should report what the same source basis supports at its own observation time while preserving the stable distinctions above.
keyFacts: Presents specific source-supported content as a current or dated observation.
Makes the as-of date visible for every changeable roster, status, version, or measurement.
Names SEP-43 as the Standard Web Wallet API Interface.
avoid: Do NOT claim SEP-43 does not exist or that the numbering skips 43 (it does exist as of 2024-04).
Do NOT invent an unrelated scope (e.g. call it an auth/anchor/payment standard).
Do NOT present version-, provider-, interface-, or availability-sensitive observations as timeless; date the changeable part without weakening stable protocol or historical facts.
